**Monitoring VM service**

I’m in the process of building and waiting for the VM service to appear. I’ll keep an eye on the logs for the “Dart VM Service URL.” To do that, I’m using a grep command to search for it. I’ll set up repeated checks in limited loops, checking every 10 seconds. It seems straightforward, just a bit of patience involved while I wait for updates!
